source.title: Reviewing laboratory equipment records
source.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
source.article: A research assistant will carry out a quarterly audit of shared laboratory equipment. The team will account for each device by matching its label with the inventory record. In response to several missing calibration dates, the supervisor has added a reminder field to the maintenance log. The next review will check whether staff have entered the dates consistently and whether any device needs servicing before the study begins.
